components.templateData:
Foundations

Typography

A responsive type system built with Inter. Use these styles to create clear hierarchy and consistent reading experiences across DDS products.

Aa

Primary typeface

Inter

A neutral, highly legible sans serif designed for interfaces and dense information.

Weights 300–700 View on Google Fonts ↗

Hierarchy

Headings

Use headings in order to structure a page. Desktop and mobile scales preserve the same hierarchy while adapting to available space.

Desktop scale

≥ 768px

Mobile scale

< 768px

Content

Body and labels

Body styles support longer reading and interface copy. Label styles add emphasis to short, actionable text such as field names and buttons.

Body

Regular · 400

Labels

Regular, medium and semibold

i

Keep hierarchy predictable

Choose styles by meaning, not appearance. Avoid skipping heading levels, and reserve labels for concise interface text rather than paragraphs.

StyleSize WeightLine Use for

{{ row.name }} {{ row.size }}{{ row.weight }} {{ row.lineHeight }}{{ row.usage }}
}
